node: Dry-type transformers and power-quality electrical equipment
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for the dry-type transformer and power-quality equipment node. The cleanest US-listed reference exposures are diversified electrical-equipment leaders, while the underfollowed lane is stronger in adjacent equipment: custom electrical distribution systems, power protection, magnetics, switchgear, and critical-power packages. Hammond Power Solutions remains a strong node reference but is not treated as a core US-listed candidate in this pass because its primary listing is Canadian and US exposure is OTC-style rather than a main US exchange listing.
